description: Exact return shape of SigData.genSong(n, themeText) in assets/engine.js. Every field is always present on archive records (JAH-SONG-%07d). 7-digit IDs: the song catalog marches to 1,000,000.

chords.description: One of 4 progression banks voiced in the song key, joined with ' - '. E.g. 'C - G - A - F'.

desc.description: Sentence of the form 'A <mood> <genre> song at <tempo> BPM in <key>, written by the Signature song engine.'

id.description: Permanent ID. Never reused. Reproducible seed is n.

key.description: E.g. 'C major', 'A# minor'. Note name from SigSynth.noteName(48 + keyIx).

lyrics.description: From SigData.writeLyrics(rng, themeText) in assets/lyrics.js (Verse/Chorus/Bridge/Outro with rhyming couplets), or the '[Verse 1]\nLa la...' fallback when writeLyrics is unavailable.

n.description: Deterministic seed. SigData.genSong(n) uses rngFrom('songrec:' + n).

structure.description: Fixed template in genSong: 'Intro (4 bars) / Verse (18) / Chorus (12) / Verse (18) / Chorus (12) / Bridge (12) / Chorus (12) / Chorus (12) / Outro (4)'.

title.description: Archive records: TITLE_A + ' ' + TITLE_B from engine.js. User-written session songs may override the title.

title: Signature Music Studio — Song record
